text:
izzy: Throwing up a new idea: instead of a full rename, move Models + Deployments under a single "Serving" group but add a compact breadcrumb that keeps org/ws context tucked behind a single toggle. Goal: tighter rail, clearer sharing.

raj: Sounds promising. Two immediate questions: 1) how do we handle old bookmarks (do a silent redirect?), and 2) keyboard discoverability for the compact crumb.

izzy: Plan: accept legacy routes server-side, but in-app normalize to /org/:o/ws/:w/serving/:panel using replaceState on first load. That avoids history noise. We'll show a one-time non-blocking toast about the change.

emma: Compact crumb behavior: make the org/ws pill a real button (aria-haspopup=menu) that expands on Enter/Space and is fully keyboard navigable. Hover can preview but must not be the only way to access it.

pavel: Routing/tech nit: prefer path-based deep links for shareability and auth redirects. Hashes are brittle across login redirects. If we still accept ?panel=foo as alias, normalize to path on share/copy.

izzy: Good — canonical rules: accept both, but canonicalize to path when copying/sharing. We'll include a tiny migration table in the PR.

a11y-bot: On any route change, ensure main landmark receives programmatic focus and an aria-live polite message announces the context (e.g., "Serving — Models"). Truncated crumb labels should have aria-labels with full text. The expand control must expose aria-expanded.

raj: UX microcopy for the migration toast: prefer concise active language. Proposal: "Models and Deployments are now under Serving. Your bookmarks will work for 120 days. Learn more." Add a clearly labeled "Dismiss" button.

emma: Motion: expand/collapse of the pill should be micro (100ms) with transform/opacity only. Panel route transitions remain slide-left (160ms). Avoid layout shifts that push main content.

pavel: Dev checklist: router alias table, replaceState normalizer on first load, scroll-snapshot/restore for long lists, unit tests for back-button behaviour, and an E2E for deep-link->auth flow preserving the final anchor.

routing-bot: Small pseudocode for alias handling:
```
if (incomingPath matches /org/:o/ws/:w/models) {
  if (isExternalRequest) return server301('/org/:o/ws/:w/serving/models')
  else history.replaceState(null, '', '/org/:o/ws/:w/serving/models')
  emitTelemetry('alias_normalized')
}
```

emma: Telemetry: track alias_normalized, pill_expand_via_keyboard, deep_link_share_method (path|query|hash), and toast_seen/dismissed. Rollout behind feature flag with 10% canary.

izzy: I'll post mocks (compact crumb collapsed/expanded, toast, and keyboard flow) in this thread shortly and attach the URL map. Thanks!
_reserved: do not add extra nested fields
